text:
zoe (Head of Finance): Quick preflight: pricing A/B starts Wed 09:00 PT. Need confirmation that grandfathered customers will never see new rates and that we have surge thresholds. Who can verify?

aj (Billing): I'll verify. Plan: blocklist by `billing_account_id`, fallback to legacy rates, and emit `billing.experiment.protected` metric.

maria: Uploaded `grandfathered_list_2029.csv` to drive. Contains `billing_account_id` + `lock_until`. Link: https://drive.internal/redwood/finance/grandfathered_list_2029.csv

lena (Sales Ops): Note: some enterprise accounts renewed early and are marked in CRM differently. I added a column `crm_flag` in the CSV. Use `billing_account_id` for joins.

sam (Engineering): Will add a runtime check in the pricing service: if account in protected list => route to legacy, no cache bypass. Deploy scheduled 2029-04-11 01:00 PT.

kevin (Revenue Ops): Thresholds proposal: auto-pause if cohort median invoice delta > $400/day OR > 7% relative uplift. Also exclude known vendor pass-through SKUs (posting list shortly).

nora (Support): Preparing KB + canned message: "Were running a controlled pricing test; if youre affected well reconcile." Will link KB here when ready.

aj (Billing): I'll run a staging dry-run tonight and post top-10 delta accounts. Command: `./bin/invoice_runner --env staging --cohort cohorts.csv --dry-run`.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook created at https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/pricing-preflight-checks by aj.

zoe: Thanks all. Final preflight sync tomorrow 08:30 PT. Please flag blockers before then. :white_check_mark:
